lines.text: We went out in the rain.
Many learners say: Despite of the rain, we went out.
Better: Despite the rain, we went out.
Despite has no of after it.
Despite! We went out despite the rain.

data.wrong: Despite of the rain, we went out.
data.right: Despite the rain, we went out.
data.why: Despite has no of after it.
